calls.claim: I'm going on the record. 27-17 Seattle. That's my pick.
calls.reasoning: He expects Seattle to stay excellent. New England was dominated in last year's Super Bowl (2 yards per play, down 19-0 through three quarters), and a similar beating would make the opening month ugly.
calls.subject: Seahawks
